name: Prenuptial Agreements
overview: Scripture affirms the sacredness and permanence of the marriage covenant, emphasizing that God hates divorce and calls believers to guard their hearts against treachery in relationships (Malachi 2:16). Jesus reminds us that from the beginning, marriage was intended to unite male and female in a lifelong bond, with divorce permitted only due to human hardness of heart (Matthew 19:4, 8). Believers are called to seek God's righteousness first in all things, including marriage (Matthew 6:33), and to follow the Father's will in honoring the covenant relationship (John 5:30). These truths guide Christians to approach prenuptial agreements with wisdom, ensuring they reflect God’s design for marriage and uphold faithfulness rather than mistrust.
